integrity_notes: Standalone verifier uses direct edge intersections and quadrature; the infinite theorem is proved analytically. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Central planes through the prism center only; all base orders are even and at least four.
Only the maximum-complexity section event is classified; full lower-complexity law and odd-sided prisms are outside scope.
Full text of Ohser–Mücklich (1995) was inaccessible; historical priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp maximal-complexity central sections of regular even-sided prisms
